description: In subscribe.ts lines 266-276, after role sync failure, the implementation re-sets the inflight operation via db.setInflightOperation(). However, updateMemberAfterSubscribe (called at line 235) already cleared inflight_operation_* fields (its params include inflight_operation_id: null). This means there is a window between updateMemberAfterSubscribe completing and setInflightOperation being called where the member has no inflight guard, violating the atomicity intent of REQ-BILL-015. A concurrent request arriving in this window could bypass the inflight guard. The comment at line 268 acknowledges this: 're-set since updateMemberAfterSubscribe cleared it'.
